title: 野村张宇：储能市场挑战与宁德时代盈利前景
speaker: Ethan Zhang

segments.en: But we do see some positive side. The recent price has been going down recently.
segments.zh: 但我们也看到一些积极方面。近期价格有所下降。

segments.en: So if this continued into next year, the cost for installing ESS would be lower.
segments.zh: 如果这一趋势延续到明年，储能系统的安装成本将降低。

segments.en: That will partially improve the overall project returns. It's a good point, right?
segments.zh: 这将部分改善整体项目回报。这是个好观点，对吧？

segments.en: You're saying the man hasn't really changed. It's really about how the industry is looking in terms of profitability, right?
segments.zh: 你说的是需求没有真正改变，关键在于行业盈利能力，对吧？

segments.en: I think a lot of your peers are talking about the 0.08 Remembe per watt hour. Is that the new normal?
segments.zh: 你的许多同行都在谈论每瓦时0.08元。这是新常态吗？

segments.en: Do you think now, or do you think unit profitability can actually recover? That's what we saw in the first half.
segments.zh: 你认为现在，还是单位盈利能力实际上可以恢复？这是我们上半年看到的。

segments.en: In the fourth quarter and maybe in next year, this could be somewhat normalized level.
segments.zh: 在四季度或明年，这可能是一个相对正常的水平。

segments.en: If you consider so the new consumption tax don't have one month impact because it's starting from September.
segments.zh: 如果考虑新消费税，由于从9月开始，不会有一个月的影响。

segments.en: It will have a full quarter impact on the fourth quarter. And for next year starting from January, there is another cut in the export VAT refound rates.
segments.zh: 它将在四季度产生完整季度影响。明年1月起，出口增值税退税税率再次下调。

segments.en: And there is another step up for the consumption tax from 2% to 4%. Starting from September next year,
segments.zh: 消费税从2%上调至4%，从明年9月开始。

segments.en: which were all these two extra tax burdens again. But we do see the company is trying to improve its overall revenue mix.
segments.zh: 这又是两项额外税收负担。但我们确实看到公司正在努力改善整体营收结构。

segments.en: This year, we see more from domestic ESS, but starting from next year, there could be more high end product sales with some regional mix change
segments.zh: 今年我们看到更多来自国内储能，但从明年开始，可能有更多高端产品销售，区域结构变化。

segments.en: and we could see more contributions from the EU market and other non-Chinese markets, which can improve their unit net profits in the mid to long-term.
segments.zh: 我们可能看到来自欧盟和其他非中国市场的更多贡献，这可以在中长期提高单位净利润。

segments.en: I'm going to ask you about the stock itself. I mean, the H shares are still trading quite a premium to the A.
segments.zh: 我要问问股票本身。H股仍相对A股有较高溢价。

segments.en: How is it different between what? Onshore and offshore investors look at the stock. And why do you think there is that gap?
segments.zh: 在岸和离岸投资者看待该股票的方式有何不同？你认为为什么存在这种差距？

segments.en: Yeah, I guess the onshore investors, sometimes they are more sensitive to these incremental changes of the market sentiment.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为在岸投资者有时对市场情绪的边际变化更敏感。

segments.en: But when I talk with some offshore investors, those long-term investors, they tend to believe CEO still remains the high-quality name,
segments.zh: 但当我与一些离岸投资者交流时，那些长期投资者倾向于认为宁德时代仍是高质量公司，

segments.en: which has a very unchallengeable position in this industry so that they do not worry that much about, for example, their Wali share loss in China or other potential challenges,
segments.zh: 在该行业拥有非常不可挑战的地位，因此他们不太担心其在中国市场份额的流失或其他潜在挑战，
